title: HiveMind memory / A2A / HyperAgent access audit

findings.title: Untrusted A2A/memory text is weakly screened, injected raw at task seed, and rendered as authoritative facts
findings.current: A2A send paths validate only non-empty length. Seed inbox inserts raw A2A text without memory_text_is_safe; refresh filters only the weak 4-marker check. prompt_block renders key = value verbatim under 'Scoped facts for this branch (authoritative):'. Raw text is persisted, published, served by HTTP, and rendered in the UI.
findings.impact: Cross-agent prompt injection and secret exposure. Newline/control content can forge extra fact rows; case/encoding variants and common credential shapes bypass the marker list.
fix: Create one core agent_text guard used before every store/publish: normalize/escape newlines and control chars; redact case-insensitive secret patterns (API keys, bearer/authorization, password/token assignments, JWT/PEM etc.); enforce length; mark [redacted].
Apply it in execute_ask_parent, execute_send_to_sibling, complete_task memory write, seed_task_context, refresh_a2a_inbox; make seed and refresh identical.
Render A2A as a separate untrusted-peer-data block; label memory with trust/provenance; never call model-authored text authoritative.
Do not rely on rendering-time redaction: DB/HTTP/event/UI are read surfaces too.

findings.title: Memory scope is the parent task (off-by-one): siblings share a bank, ancestors are never read, and memory facts are inherited across branches
findings.current: seed_task_context reads scope = task.parent_task_id or 'root'; complete_task writes the same scope. A child reads the bank where its siblings write, not its parent's own memory; root reads only 'root'; descendants inherit parent context memory facts (only a2a:/roster: are filtered).
findings.impact: Horizontal cross-branch leakage (later siblings/descendants see peer memory), missing vertical inheritance (children/root cannot see parent memory), spawn-order-dependent prompts and replay drift.
fix: Write memory to the writing task's own scope (or a real bank id); never the parent's id.
Read an explicit set: own + each ancestor up to depth 4 + role bank, at a recorded revision; no generic parent-id query.
Do not inherit memory: facts from parent context; read ancestors explicitly.
If adopting the bank tree, use memory_banks/memory_entries and invariants I1-I12 from docs/research/hmars/04-memory-architecture.md.

findings.title: Root has no all-bank/hive aggregate read and silently drops task 33+ in its final prompt
findings.current: Root context queries only the 'root' scope. The uncommitted final turn builds its prompt from tasks_for_run(...).take(32) with raw task_result text; MAX_AGENTS is 64, so up to 32 tasks are silently omitted. No execution.rs call reads agent_memory_entries_for_run/all banks; only HTTP does. No aggregate prompt budget or trust labels.
findings.impact: Final answer can ignore up to half the allowed tasks; branch/hive memory is unavailable to the orchestrator; raw child text enters without provenance; prompt size/cost are unbounded by aggregate budget.
fix: Add a root-only aggregate read: run bank + one bounded summary/observation per hive/branch with trust, counts, and omitted count.
Do not silently take(32): include all required summaries within an explicit total char budget, or record/report omitted tasks in the prompt and a root_aggregate record.
Keep aggregation root-only and summary-oriented; do not expose raw descendant observations.

findings.title: ask_parent is write-only; inbox refreshes only at task start; no wake/answer/status; terminal recipients lose messages
findings.current: refresh_a2a_inbox is called in execute_task_with_prompt and execute_root_task_with_prompt only. The continuation loop never refreshes. ask_parent returns {message_id,to_task_id,kind}; agent_messages has no status/in_reply_to/answered_at; no wait/wake. send_to_sibling/ask_parent do not check recipient state.
findings.impact: A question sent during the parent's tool turn or approval wait is invisible in later parent turns; if the parent completes, the message is durable but undelivered and the child proceeds on a guess. Sender gets ok for undeliverable rows; budget is consumed; mailbox cannot show answer/open/expired.
fix: Add internal message status/in_reply_to/answered_at/expires_at and delivery tracking.
Refresh the inbox before every provider continuation; wake a queued/awaiting recipient; reject or mark terminal recipients undeliverable.
Implement minimal answer path: parent/operator answers, answered message reaches child next turn, unanswered expires with a named refusal; answer never grants tool authority.
If blocking is deferred, return an explicit open/pending status and remove any implication of an answer.

findings.title: Clear memory deletes all runs/scopes for a role, is one-click/unconfirmed, and has no scope, receipt, or audit
findings.current: DELETE /api/agents/memory/{agent_key} deletes every row with that agent_key (all runs/scopes). HTTP and UI execute immediately; CLI requires --yes but has no run/scope flags. No run/branch clear exists; no receipt/journal/tombstone.
findings.impact: A single click or HTTP call erases active and past run memory with no confirmation or recovery; operators cannot audit erasure; the safe scoped operation is unavailable.
fix: Add scoped clear routes/CLI/UI: run, run+scope, role; global only with explicit all=true/confirmation token.
Require confirmation dialog/--yes naming exact run/scope/key; return purge receipt and write append-only journal/audit row.
Never show unlabeled global Clear on the memory panel; use soft-delete/tombstone if retention requires undo.

findings.title: Run/branch rows and 'durable role memory' are conflated; global list is cross-run and persona-only; legacy scopes are unreachable
findings.current: v11 backfills legacy rows to scope 'legacy'; seed/refresh read parent/root scopes only, so legacy rows (and rows written by record_agent_memory as scope 'run') are never recalled. GET /api/agents/memory iterates boot personas and calls a store query that filters agent_key only across all runs/scopes; arbitrary task roles are not listed. UI labels that union 'durable role memory' with only key/value.
findings.impact: Cross-run data is presented as role memory without provenance; destructive clear targets it; legacy rows are invisible to recall; arbitrary task roles are invisible to the UI list yet clearable.
fix: Separate read-mostly agent_role bank from run/hive/branch banks; never aggregate task-written rows as role memory.
Migrate legacy rows to the role bank with original run/task ids, trust=NULL, kind=note; migrate or remove the legacy 'run' scope with a documented rule.
Return run_id/scope_id/task_id/created_at/trust in API/CLI/UI; deprecate record_agent_memory or align it with the role bank.
Ensure every write scope is read by its intended consumer; test.

findings.area: A2A recipient validation / budget / delivery status
findings.title: Recipient state is unvalidated, the 32-message budget is check-then-insert (TOCTOU), and delivery/read/answer status does not exist
findings.current: No target.state check; terminal recipients accept messages. Budget count and insert are separate statements with no atomic guard. No status/delivered_at/answered_at/in_reply_to fields; UI displays rows as if delivered.
findings.impact: ok is returned for undeliverable messages; budget can exceed 32 under concurrent siblings; no way to implement answer/wake or an honest mailbox; silent loss.
fix: Validate recipient state: active states deliverable; terminal refused (E_TASK_TERMINAL) or marked undeliverable, never ok.
Make count+insert one transaction/statement/trigger; add idempotency key for retries.
Add status/in_reply_to/delivered_at/answered_at/expires_at; surface in tool result/HTTP/UI; keep AGENT_MESSAGE frozen fields if avoiding a contract change.

findings.title: Roster is seeded once, silently truncated at 16, never refreshed, exposes all topology, and is cacheable
findings.current: Roster facts inserted at task seed, take(16), not refreshed by refresh_a2a_inbox. HTTP roster serializes all tasks with no truncated/count/limit marker, no state filter, no no-store; prompt exposes all branch ids/roles/parents.
findings.impact: Later peers are undiscoverable; model believes truncated roster complete; stale cache; cross-branch topology disclosure.
fix: Refresh roster before each turn with bounded scan and omitted count; refresh after spawns.
Add truncated/total/limit/state filtering and Cache-Control: no-store; make discovery scope policy explicit.
Validate authorization separately (roster is discovery, not send permission).

findings.title: Approved cross-branch send writes without re-verifying approved args/target or single-use grant
findings.current: suspend_for_approval is used for cross-branch send, but the approve path special-cases send_to_sibling and calls execute_send_to_sibling(...true) without verify_tool_grant or args_sha256 comparison; target state is not rechecked. Positive test only.
findings.impact: Approval is weaker than the WP-01 side-effect grant protocol; a mismatched/replayed approval or target-state change is not caught at the point of effect.
fix: Before message write, verify engine-held resolution: approval id/nonce consumed once, request.tool == plan.tool, request.args_sha256 == hash_args(plan.args), run/target relationships unchanged; or equivalent verify_tool_grant path.
Re-check target state after approval; store approval id on message/ledger.
Add negative args/target mismatch tests.

findings.title: Memory and inbox read errors are swallowed as empty; 8/500/200/32 caps have no truncation markers
findings.current: if let Ok(...) silently drops memory read errors; inbox read errors return unchanged context. Recall caps 8, inbox 8/500 chars, HTTP memory 200 with no omitted/truncated; run memory response has count only.
findings.impact: Empty vs broken is indistinguishable; operators/models believe they saw all memory/messages; incidents are unauditable.
fix: Surface named read failure in context/prompt/log and keep existing facts; never empty-success.
Add truncated/omitted counts to store return types, HTTP/UI, and prompt facts; add render budget and record.
Distinguish no rows from read failure in tests.

findings.area: API / CLI / UI parity and cache
findings.title: UI lacks roster and sender/recipient filters; clear safety differs across surfaces; memory/roster responses are missing no-store
findings.current: API/CLI support task_id/from_task_id/kind and roster; UI mailbox only kind and no roster panel. API run memory supports scope; UI fetches all and client-filters. Clear is global in all surfaces but only CLI requires --yes. /api/agents/memory and /api/agents/runs/{id}/roster lack Cache-Control: no-store (messages/run memory have it).
findings.impact: Operators cannot exercise supported API features in the UI; destructive action is safest in CLI and weakest in UI; stale cached sensitive data is possible.
fix: Implement one surface contract: add roster UI, mailbox sender/recipient filters, scope query use, scoped clear with confirmation.
Add no-store to memory/roster/message responses; test headers.
Make clear confirmation consistent (server token + UI dialog + CLI --yes/all).

findings.title: Missing recipient index/task FKs, nondeterministic memory ordering, no retention/purge receipt
findings.current: agent_messages: run FK only, no task FK/retry unique key, only run index; inbox filters run+to_task_id. agent_memory: no FKs/retention, clear-only deletion. Memory ORDER BY created_at DESC lacks rowid tie-break (messages include it). No pagination/cursor.
findings.impact: At current caps low: orphan/stale rows, nondeterministic recall, no retention/erasure receipt, inefficient query at scale.
fix: Add (run_id,to_task_id,created_at) index (and sender if used), task FKs or boot cleanup; add retry/idempotency key.
Add rowid DESC tie-breakers to memory queries.
Add retention/expiry or documented sweep; purge by run/scope with journal/receipt; cursor/truncated for endpoints.

missing_tests: No engine-level branch-isolation/leakage test (store unit tests only; run_lifecycle covers cross-run non-recall and roster presence, not prompt facts).
No root aggregate or >32-task truncation test.
No negative foreign-run/foreign-parent/terminal/self send tests (claim register 17:40,43).
No clear scope/confirmation/journal test beyond global HTTP delete.
No secret-redaction/newline-injection test; no memory/inbox failure-visibility test.
No truncation/cache-header test; no legacy-migration/ordering test.
No cross-branch approval args/target binding negative test.
positive_controls: HTTP A2A filters validate unknown/foreign task ids and kind (http.rs:841-886; http_boot.rs:352-377).
send_to_sibling same-run/same-parent checks exist (execution.rs:2647-2657); self-target/malformed target refused.
Cross-branch send suspends for approval and does not write before it (execution.rs:1790-1815; tests/suspension.rs:472-542).
No sender id in tool args; sender derives from executing task.
Per-run 32-message budget exists; cross-run memory recall is blocked by run_id filters (store.rs:759-829; run_lifecycle.rs:506-549).
